source: BDS 1.26.60.6 Linux, read from the running server's memory once it started (bds-runtime-dump skill): which faces of each block hold what is attached to them. Rules: all, top, bottom, ends (top and bottom), not_top, or a rule that reads the block's state. A block not listed holds nothing. hang_from lists blocks a lantern may also hang from; solid lists the blocks a ladder may lean on.
